claim: Fietsen door de Bomen at Pijnven (Kiefhoekstraat 16, Hechtel-Eksel) is a free 700m double-circle bike bridge rising 3–4% to 10m height, open sunrise to sunset and accessible for walkers, wheelchairs and bikes.
quote: Accessible for cyclists, walkers and wheelchair users from sunrise to sunset ... path gradually rises (3-4%) to 10 meters height

claim: Fietsen door de Bomen is a 700-metre double-circle cycle bridge in Bosland with 100m diameter, located in Pijnven, Hechtel-Eksel.
quote: Fietsen door de Bomen in het Pijnven in Hechtel-Eksel is een iconische fietsbrug ... een dubbele cirkel met een doorsnede van 100 meter en maar liefst 700 meter lang

claim: The Uitkijktoren ('Reus van Bosland') in the Lommelse Sahara is 30 m high, free to visit and accessible 24/7, with views up to 25 km; 4.6/5 rating across 253 reviews and ranked #1 of 24 things to do in Lommel.
quote: The observation tower stands 30 meters tall ... The attraction is completely free to visit ... accessible 24/7 ... rating of 4.6 out of 5 across 253 reviews and ranks #1 of 24 things to do in Lommel

claim: The Lommelse Sahara offers a 3.1 km blue children's trail through a play forest with willow-branch play elements, plus 5.9 km orange and 12 km red routes; sand makes it unsuitable for strollers.
quote: the blue route shows the most beautiful spots of the Sahara and offers plenty of variety for young and old ... the children's walk in the Sahara, passing through the mysterious play forest with natural play elements made of willow branches

claim: Sportcentrum De Soeverein in Lommel has a 25x15 m six-lane competition pool at 28°C plus a 10x12 m subtropical kids' pool at 31°C; single-swim entry is €4.20 for Lommel residents and €5.20 for non-residents.
quote: The competition pool is 25x15 meters with six lanes ... subtropical pool of 10x12 meters with a temperature around 31°C ... Lommel residents pay €4.20 and non-residents pay €5.20

claim: De Soeverein (Sportveldenstraat 15, 3920 Lommel) includes a separate children's pool, wellness with sauna/jacuzzi/steam, family water slide, outdoor spray park and brasserie with playground — but no ice rink on site.
quote: Separate children's pool · Wellness area with sauna, jacuzzi, and steam room · Family water slide · Outdoor spray park · Brasserie with playground ... There is no ice rink mentioned at this location

claim: Provinciaal Recreatiedomein Zilvermeer (Mol) charges €5 online per day for swimming + playground (age 6+), free under 6; tickets are date-locked and capacity-capped on warm days so pre-booking is advised.
quote: Swimming & Playground (ages 6+): €5 online ... Swimming & Playground (under 6): Free ... dit ticket is enkel geldig op de door jouw gekozen dag

claim: Zilvermeer features a sandy-beach swimming pond with climbing tower, water slides and whirlpools plus kayak, sail, tennis and volleyball — roughly 20 km from Lommel.
quote: plenty of water fun in the swimming pond with a climbing tower and water slides, whirlpools and a nice white sand beach ... swim as well as kayak, sail, play tennis, volleyball and more

claim: Center Parcs De Vossemeren in Lommel sells day tickets to non-staying visitors for around €25–€27 per person; Aqua Mundo includes a wave pool, wild-water rapids, slides, kids' pool and outdoor pool, plus paid add-ons like laser battle, paintball and High Adventure Experience.
quote: purchase a day ticket at the cashier for €27 per person, though ticket prices are around €25 per person ... wave pool, wildwater rapids, slides, a children's pool, outdoor pool ... air mattress water park, laser battle, paintball, Action Factory, and the High Adventure Experience

claim: Outdoor Adventure Parc Warredal in Maaseik (~30 km from Lommel) has seven climbing courses of varying difficulty plus a 200 m zipline, adult target price €24.95, by appointment only.
quote: Ketelstraat 77, 3680 Maaseik ... Target price (adult) € 24,95 ... seven courses offering different heights and levels of difficulty ... 200-meter zipline ... only available on appointment

claim: Blueberry Fields in Koersel (Beringen, ~25 km from Lommel) opens self-pick blueberry season mid-July to mid-August, 09:00–16:30 with €5 family entry refunded if you pick 1 kg; no reservation needed.
quote: Self-picking starts at 9:00 AM and the last pickers leave at 4:30 PM ... entrance fee is €5 per family, which is deducted if you pick at least 1 kg ... mid-July to mid-August

claim: Blauwe Meer at Kattenbos 169 in Lommel is an officially recognised supervised swimming pond with 'zeer goed' (very good) water-quality rating as of 15-09-2025.
quote: Op Kattenbos 169 in Lommel bevindt zich een zwemvijver, en de laatste waterkwaliteitsmeting op 15-09-2025 toonde een 'zeer goed' beoordeling

claim: Indoor Karting Lommel (Balendijk 171) runs a 500 m multi-level track with 200cc Honda karts, open to drivers from 1m50 tall, with on-site bowling and bar.
quote: 500-meter multi-level track ... children able to go-karting as young as 1m50 tall ... bowling as an additional activity available at the location

claim: Klimbos De Hoge Rielen in Kasterlee (slightly outside 30 km of Lommel) is closed 1 Dec 2025 – 1 Mar 2026; courses are for ages 11+ and ≥1.40 m, 2.5 hours, minimum 12 people, bookable by phone/email only.
quote: winterstop van 1 december 2025 t.e.m. 1 maart 2026 ... geschikt voor kinderen vanaf 11 jaar en minstens 1.40 meter groot ... minimale groepsgrootte is 12 personen
